name: IVBF
decision_note: Prague-managed blockchain fund for accredited investors (Core Fund in BTC, ETH, HYPE and SOL; Yield Fund in stablecoins) - a crypto asset strategy, not investment in private companies.

evidence.quote: IVBF is a professionally managed blockchain fund for accredited investors seeking long-term exposure to digital assets without gambling, guesswork, or price anxiety.
The minimum entry requirement is €125,000, consistent across both Core and Yield Funds.
IVBF is part of the Impulse Capital group, known for early investments in standout tech companies like Kiwi.com and Shoptet.

analyst_notes: Quick exclusion dossier (E3, crypto). The own site describes two liquid digital-asset strategies: a Core Fund benchmarked to BTC that holds BTC, ETH, HYPE and SOL (with staking, OTC and liquidity provision) and a Yield Fund fully in stablecoins earning from market making and arbitrage; EUR/USD 125k minimum per investor (e2, an LP minimum, not a ticket). No equity investments in private companies found. Investor type left null because the strategy is not private-company investing. Legal entity IVBF, s.r.o. (IČO 14366037, Praha 7, 2022; NACE 6499). The site says IVBF belongs to the Impulse Capital group (early investor in Kiwi.com and Shoptet, e3) - that group was not screened here.
